About Me

Teaching Philosophy & Approach

"In the volatile landscape of AI and Cybersecurity, pedagogy must be as dynamic as the technology itself."

I bridge the gap between complex theoretical frameworks and practical industry application using evidence-based strategies tailored to diverse learners. Through an Adaptive Learning Architecture, I design flexible curricula that challenge high achievers while providing scaffolded support for developing students.

Central to my mission is Research-Informed Instruction — integrating emerging academic trends to cultivate a forward-looking mindset. I believe technical mastery must be paired with ethical responsibility. My Holistic Mentorship model balances rigorous skill development with an inclusive, approachable environment.

Guest Lectures

Topics I Can Deliver

Available for guest lectures, workshops, and panel discussions at universities, conferences, and professional events.

01
Artificial Intelligence
Foundations of AI, machine learning concepts, neural networks, and real-world applications across industries. Suitable for undergraduate and postgraduate audiences.
02
AI in Cybersecurity
How artificial intelligence is transforming threat detection, incident response, and cyber defence strategies. Includes case studies and emerging trends.
03
Ethical Hacking & Cyber Forensics
Penetration testing methodology, digital forensics investigation, evidence handling, and the legal framework surrounding ethical hacking.
04
AI Ethics in Education
Responsible use of AI tools in academic environments, bias in algorithmic systems, and how educators can teach ethical AI thinking to the next generation.
05
Web & Mobile Development
Modern full-stack web development with HTML, CSS, PHP, and MySQL. Android application development using Java and Firebase — from concept to deployment.
06
Research Methods in Computing
Introduction to academic research in technology fields — formulating research questions, literature review techniques, and selecting appropriate methodologies.

"My strength lies in making complex technical subjects accessible — whether in a lecture hall, a workshop, or a one-to-one mentoring session."

With experience delivering Pearson-accredited programmes at HND, BSc, and MSc level, I bring both the academic rigour of UK university education and the practical understanding of what industry demands from computing graduates.

Beyond lecturing, I serve as a mentor at the National Science and Technology Council (NSTC), India — guiding researchers, Master's-level students, and PhD scholars in their academic and research journeys.
